نرتدي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَدِي (nartadī) /nar.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَدَى (irtadā)
# نَرْتَدِيَ (nartadiya) /nar.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَدَى (irtadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
